name: @aws-sdk/client-rekognition
description: AWS SDK for JavaScript Rekognition Client for Node.js, Browser and React Native

readme.summary: The README covers the AWS SDK v3 generally well but is a generic monorepo README rather than documentation specific to @aws-sdk/client-rekognition, with all examples using DynamoDB instead of Rekognition.
readme.top_issue: This README is for the entire AWS SDK JS v3 monorepo, not for client-rekognition specifically — there are zero Rekognition-specific examples, API references, or use cases.
